ratings.note: Every first reservation; toast vanishes and nothing says a session and confirmation remain, so a member can leave with nothing reserved and find out at the desk.
Confirm page (screenshot) shows Saturday 17 in Tools row and Wednesday 21 as session; ambiguity on the one fact that matters, at the commit point.
Desktop keyboard users only; extra tab stops through ten links, recurring.
Search after ten cards on phones; with a ten-tool catalogue browsing still works, so mainly a detour for those who want search.
Results change out of view after Search on phones; member may conclude search failed. Recoverable by scrolling once understood.
Brand/identity concern; no task consequence shown, so cosmetic.
Screen-reader users navigating by heading; less efficient but content reachable.
About 3.1:1 on availability text in dark mode, which many older members use; date also shown on the tool page.
320 px / high zoom only; sideways scroll on every card.
Every reservation hits an empty session group and an error after a day was already chosen; recoverable with one more choice.
Keyboard users only; workaround is choosing an option.
Every completed reservation leaves 'Basket (1)'; heading says confirmed, but doubt and a possible duplicate attempt.
Second loan option hidden under the bar at default scroll on phones; only two options, revealed by scrolling.
Same dark-mode contrast failure on the availability pill as B-006, rated the same.
Flat heading outline for screen-reader users plus oversized basket titles; minor.
Members who reserve in short bursts are not told the hold is limited; the hold does expire (see expired-hold finding), so the uncertainty has a real cost.
Rare path (second reservation same session, or new tab), but shows a wrong or merged reservation number.
Keyboard and screen-reader users get the opposite order from the visual one; arrow keys move visually backwards; risk of wrong session.
Identical placeholder thumbnails; titles still identify tools, so mainly appeal.
Instruction explains the dot and dots are visible in the capture; the harm of a wrong day is rated in the closed-day findings. (Suggested 3.)
Same placement problem as B-067 viewed as inconsistency; detour on phones, small catalogue.
Members who reserve in short bursts can exceed the hold; generic error and every retry fails, so the task is blocked and a desk call is likely.
Closed-day problem surfaces only after details are entered, with no link back; significant rework on the critical path.
Nav labels wrap on phones; no task consequence shown (impact text does not match the finding).
Duplicate of the latest-first session order; full dates on each card, so mainly slower scanning with occasional wrong pick.
Keyboard or large-text users on short viewports: focused control and the chosen option can be fully hidden (2.4.11).
Brand layer absent; no usability consequence shown.
Same search placement issue as B-067; detour on phones.
Only members who change loan length or day; remove and redo.
Double tap within 1.5 s (more likely given no busy state) creates two reservation numbers.
Screen-reader users who press Reserve first do not learn why nothing happened.
Same 320 px overflow as B-066, code-level cause.
Near-identical drill names truncated on phones; full name on the tool page, so extra navigation or a wrong open.
Same as B-033: chosen day not carried to the session group; an error on a step members think is done.
Duplicate of search placement on phones.
Bar covers calendar rows while scrolling and overhangs the column at desktop; scroll recovers.
Members using Change after typing must retype three fields on a phone and may doubt the reservation survived.
Screen-reader users hear 'One week, button' without the label; inferable from the heading.
Every Continue and Confirm press shows no change for over a second; invites repeat taps (which create duplicates on Confirm).
Screen-reader users hear the tool name twice on the confirmation; minor confusion.
Desktop layout of sessions; uneven cards and wrapped labels slow comparison.
No user-visible effect today; maintainability issue, not a usability problem for members.
Duplicate of truncated tool names on phones.
Same as B-065.
Two label column widths in spec list; visual only.
Date-filter users (filter is hidden behind an icon) get results that contradict the helper text and may conclude later tools are unavailable.
Every reservation sees sessions latest first; full dates on each option and the confirm summary limit wrong picks.
Same latest-first order as B-048.
Same no-pending-state issue as B-013, observed by timing.
No month label and toast briefly over the weekday header; month inferable.
Icon-only filter button gates the date filter needed for top task 3; first-time and older members may not find it.
Stale error after choosing a day, common since Reserve is visible first on phones; contradictory but recoverable.
Duplicate of B-037: reservation confirmed before the tool is back; wasted trip.
Day and session asked separately and never reconciled; contradiction whenever they differ, on the fact the member must get right.
Footer under the bar and focused days can be covered; the focus case overlaps B-054.
3 of 10 tools; confirmation says it is arranged and the member travels for a tool still out on loan. Never caught at any step.
Persona does not know session days and 15 of 21 days are closed; wrong day accepted and kept in the summary.
Keyboard users are trapped in the listbox until they choose with Enter; not obvious how to leave.
Occasional slips lose the tool set-up with no undo, and the tool may be taken meanwhile.
Common variants (+44, spaced numbers, lower case) rejected; retype after reading the example.
Screen-reader users moving by landmark miss the primary action; still reachable.
Latest-first order as B-048; listing sessions before the pick-up day is covered by the reconciliation finding.
Heading clearly says 'Reservation confirmed'; lack of emphasis is visual polish.
Duplicate of 320 px overflow.
Desktop session layout plus order; slower comparison.
Few members reserve four tools; those who do are refused some in person.
Duplicate of truncated names on phones.
First-time phone users likely press Reserve before seeing the calendar; error then recovery.
Filter users see yyyy/mm/dd against en-GB convention; minor.
Two badge styles unexplained; date text correct, misreading occasional.
Duplicate of B-036: closed days accepted without warning; rated the same.
Empty space at desktop widths; visual only.
Lower-case or unhyphenated membership numbers, common on phone keyboards, get the empty-field message; one retry once the pattern is seen.
No-match searches show all ten tools as if they matched and announce nothing; misleading.
Ten-minute hold with no warning or extension (2.2.1); members in short bursts exceed it unknowingly. Blocking consequence rated in B-017.
